description: The true path of the miniature: a theft that needed its thief to know the hiding-place; the one person told, at the funeral with the narrator; the errand boy away and never told; the letter read aloud, and the lodger who heard it.

moves.see: the only one Ann Tolley ever told
moves.why: I told nobody but Jane where the box was.

moves.see: beside Ann Tolley the whole hour
moves.why: And Jane was with me the whole time the shop was shut.
Not Jane: she was beside me.
Whoever it was went straight to the board.
No chance thief would leave the till.
Dick was on his round all that hour.
Jane read my letter out at her table.

moves.see: Mr. Voss heard where the box was

moves.why: The one who knew, and was not with me.
